adopt: Sign one release file and hand someone the verify command.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
"Download this and run it" is a request for trust with nothing behind it.

Install
pip install awseal

Commands
  awseal

Quick start
  pip install awseal
  
  awseal keygen # once
  awseal sign./my-adapter --subject my-adapter # writes awseal.json
  awseal pubkey # publish this
  
  # someone else, later:
  awseal verify./my-adapter --key <your-public-key>

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awseal/
synopsis: Sign an artifact so a stranger can verify it.
